category_title: Students who communicate knowledge through visual and performing arts to overcome vocabulary limitations
student_description: This student is highly persistent and motivated by creative projects, but struggles significantly with traditional written assignments due to vocabulary limitations. They thrive when allowed to demonstrate comprehension through visual or performing arts and respond best to open-ended questions and choices in media, whereas strict directives or direct correction hinder their progress.

criteria.rationale: Long-term engagement requires the student to know they will not be penalized for vocabulary limitations on final assessments.
criteria.check: The long-term plan must include offering the student open-ended format choices (such as visual or performing arts) for their summative presentations.

criteria.rationale: Involving this student in the rubric creation process early in the unit challenges them to think critically and increases their investment in the learning process.
criteria.check: The long-term plan must include a step where the student is actively involved in developing or adjusting the assessment rubric for their projects.
